facts.fact: 辛西娅认出包间里的贵妇是巴克尔索恩夫人，她领导“上流淑女会”。
facts.anchor: ‘That’s Lady Bucklethorne,’ she hissed to Helena. ‘She leads the Society of Genteel Ladies.’

facts.fact: 海伦娜说高处的镜子其实是单向观察窗。
facts.anchor: ‘They aren’t mirrors. It’s a special window that allows the person on the other side to see out, while we only see our reflections.’

facts.fact: 辛西娅用“肯特米尔侯爵夫人”的身份给自己壮胆。
facts.anchor: I am the Marchioness of Kentmore. I do not shudder in the face of danger.

facts.fact: 辛西娅一见辛克莱就觉得他像魔鬼本尊，但对他毫无心动。
facts.anchor: If she ever wondered what the Devil might look like, she no longer needed to guess.

facts.fact: 辛克莱威胁说自己是“死亡的化身”，警告她们别与他作对。
facts.anchor: your friend might be dangerous, but I am death incarnate. Do not fuck with me. You will not survive the experience.

facts.fact: 辛西娅说明来意：查清休伯特的欠款并替他了结。
facts.anchor: ‘I understand my recently deceased husband was in debt to you. I wish to know how much he owed so I can settle his accounts.

facts.fact: 章末辛西娅直接问辛克莱，丈夫的债是否与他的死有关。
facts.anchor: ‘Did my husband’s debt to you play a role in his untimely death?’
